build_fast_language_model: build a quantized LLM using FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained with 4bit QLoRA loading and gradient checkpointing
create_fast_model_vision: create a vision-language model using FastVisionModel.from_pretrained for multimodal image-text generation
create_fast_model_text: create a text-only embedding model using FastTextModel.from_pretrained with optional 4bit quantization
run_fast_inference_vllm: run fast vLLM inference with FastLanguageModel.from_pretrained using fast_inference and gpu_memory_utilization
refactor_peft_lora: refactor a PEFT LoRA adapter into a trained model using FastModel.from_pretrained with is_peft detection and PeftModel merging
